goalOneSentence: Verify GET /payments/status returns HTTP 200 with a body, hermetically (1 request = 1 response), via a QaaS runner against a static mocker stub on port 8090.

tasks.title: Scaffold runner and mocker projects
tasks.description: Create two .NET 10 console projects. Runner/Runner.csproj: Project Sdk Microsoft.NET.Sdk; PropertyGroup with OutputType Exe, TargetFramework net10.0, ImplicitUsings enable, Nullable enable; PackageReference QaaS.Runner Version * plus QaaS.Common.Generators Version * plus QaaS.Common.Assertions Version * (FB s01, s13#8); ItemGroup with None Update payment.qaas.yaml CopyToOutputDirectory Always and None Update TestData\**\* CopyToOutputDirectory Always (FB s01 - config-file-not-found trap). Runner/Program.cs is exactly one line: QaaS.Runner.Bootstrap.New(args).Run(); (FB s01). Mocker/Mocker.csproj: same PropertyGroup; PackageReference QaaS.Mocker Version * plus QaaS.Common.Processors Version *; None Update payment.mocker.yaml CopyToOutputDirectory Always. Mocker/Program.cs is exactly one line: QaaS.Mocker.Bootstrap.New(args).Run(); Do NOT create any YAML files in this task.
acceptanceCriteria: dotnet build -c Release exits 0 in Runner
dotnet build -c Release exits 0 in Mocker
rubric: csproj structure matches FB s01 golden shape (no invented MSBuild properties)
Program.cs is the exact one-liner, no extra code
failureModes: Missing QaaS.Common.* package refs -> FTL hook not found at run time (FB s13#8)
Missing CopyToOutputDirectory -> config file not found (FB s01)

tasks.title: Author runner YAML, mocker YAML, and test data
tasks.description: Author three files. (1) Runner/payment.qaas.yaml following the FB s14.1 golden shape exactly: MetaData with Team: Payments and System: PSP-Status; Storages list with one item: - FileSystem: {Path: ./session-data}; DataSources list with one item: Name: StatusRequests, Generator: FromFileSystem, GeneratorConfiguration: {DataArrangeOrder: AsciiAsc, FileSystem: {Path: TestData}}; Sessions list with one Session: Name: PaymentStatusSession, Transactions list with one Transaction: Name: CallPaymentStatus, TimeoutMs: 10000, DataSourceNames: [StatusRequests] (REQUIRED - FB s13#3), Http: {BaseAddress: http://127.0.0.1, Port: 8090, Route: payments/status, Method: Get} where Route has NO leading slash (FB s13#5); Assertions list with TWO assertions: (a) Assertion: HttpStatus, Name: StatusIs200, AssertionConfiguration: {StatusCode: 200, OutputNames: [CallPaymentStatus]}; (b) Assertion: HermeticByExpectedOutputCount, Name: ExactlyOneResponse, AssertionConfiguration: {OutputNames: [CallPaymentStatus], ExpectedCount: 1} where the field is ExpectedCount NOT ExpectedOutputCount (FB s13#12) - this guard is required because HttpStatus alone passes vacuously when zero outputs arrive (FB s13#13). (2) Runner/TestData/status-request.json: small JSON object with merchantId M-1001 and paymentId P-77001. (3) Mocker/payment.mocker.yaml following the FB s14.2 verified shape exactly - top-level keys DataSources, Stubs, Servers: DataSources: []; Stubs list with one stub: Name: StatusOkStub, Processor: StaticResponseProcessor, ProcessorConfiguration (key is ProcessorConfiguration NOT TransactionData - FB s13#1): {Body: the JSON text {"status":"SETTLED"}, StatusCode: 200, ContentType: application/json}; Servers list with one item: - Http: {Port: 8090, Endpoints: [- Path: /payments/status (mocker Path KEEPS the leading slash - FB s13#5), Actions: [- Name: PaymentStatusOk, Method: Get, TransactionStubName: StatusOkStub]]}.
acceptanceCriteria: dotnet run -- template payment.qaas.yaml exits 0 with no 'not found in' warnings
dotnet run -- template payment.mocker.yaml exits 0 with no 'not found in' warnings
HermeticByExpectedOutputCount with ExpectedCount present in runner YAML
rubric: YAML matches FB s14 golden shapes (section names, nesting, casing)
Both drift-trap keys correct: ProcessorConfiguration, ExpectedCount
Assertions reference the transaction by OutputNames exactly
failureModes: DataSourceNames missing -> FTL config invalid (FB s13#3)
HttpStatus without hermetic guard -> vacuous pass (FB s13#13)

tasks.title: Run end-to-end and report
tasks.description: Write Runner/RUN-REPORT.md documenting the exact end-to-end run procedure and expected evidence for this sprint: (1) start the mocker first from the Mocker project directory with: dotnet run -c Release -- run payment.mocker.yaml, and wait for the boot line 'HTTP Server started. Listening on http://0.0.0.0:8090' (FB s06); (2) from the Runner project directory (MUST cd into the project dir - config paths resolve against CWD, FB s13 CWD trap) run: dotnet run -c Release -- run payment.qaas.yaml; (3) expected green evidence: log lines 'Finished running executions. Aggregated exit code: 0' and 'Runner completed. ExitCode=0', process exit code 0 (FB s06); (4) artifacts to inspect afterwards: allure-results/*-result.json one per assertion with status passed, allure-results/SessionsData/<ts>/*.json containing Outputs with Http StatusCode 200, allure-results/Templates/<ts>/template.yaml (FB s07); (5) failure triage pointer: if exit is 1, split root cause with the act / assert verbs per the diagnose-failure skill. The harness verify gate will execute this exact procedure mechanically.
acceptanceCriteria: End-to-end live run exits 0 with 'ExitCode=0' in output
RUN-REPORT.md documents mocker-first ordering, CWD rule, exact commands, expected log lines, artifact paths

verify.cmd: $m = Start-Process dotnet -ArgumentList 'run','-c','Release','--','run','payment.mocker.yaml' -WorkingDirectory '..\Mocker' -PassThru; $ok = $false; foreach ($i in 1..40) { try { (New-Object Net.Sockets.TcpClient('127.0.0.1', 8090)).Close(); $ok = $true; break } catch { Start-Sleep 2 } }; if (-not $ok) { Stop-Process -Id $m.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output 'MOCKER NEVER READY'; exit 9 }; dotnet run -c Release -- run payment.qaas.yaml; $code = $LASTEXITCODE; Stop-Process -Id $m.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit $code

rubric: Report states mocker-first ordering and the CWD rule
Expected log lines and artifact paths are exact (no invented paths)
failureModes: Running from solution dir instead of project dir (FB s13 CWD trap)
Runner started before mocker is listening -> connection refused -> red

portContract: This sprint's mocker(s) MUST listen on HTTP port 8090. Every runner Transaction MUST target http://127.0.0.1:8090 (set the mocker server Port: 8090 and the runner BaseAddress/Port to 8090). Do NOT use the 8080 default from Fact Base examples - use 8090 exactly, or the live end-to-end run cannot connect.
